column1: # molecules.tsv - which residue is what, and its colour
# One line per rule:   PATTERN   CLASS   RED GREEN BLUE   (0 to 1)
# PATTERN is compared with the residue name (* = any characters, ? = one).
# The FIRST line that matches wins: put exact names above general patterns.
# All residues of one CLASS share one colour (that of the first line of the
# class). At most 16 classes can have their own colour.
#   water, ion   hidden unless asked for; their colour here is used
#   sterol       drawn as a rigid ring, without head/tail distinction
# Any other class name is free (it is only a label): the molecule is drawn
# as heads + tails. Tail beads are those named like C1A, D2B, T1A.
# A residue matching no line is drawn the same way, coloured by VMD.
# ---- ionizable and cationic lipids (LNP); H at the end = protonated
